answer: Because the inlet ordering is published with the ferrous batch, the ocean audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 14% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A farm that floods the queue early therefore gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 429 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
